steps.title: Project Foundation & Medical Theme Layout
steps.description: Establish responsive Tailwind CSS layout structure, medical cyan/slate color palette, and meta tags.

steps.title: Navigation & Urgent Care Announcement Bar
steps.description: Create sticky navigation bar with quick contact, mobile drawer, operating status, and appointment CTA.

steps.title: Physician Hero Section with Verified Badges
steps.description: Construct high-converting hero section with doctor credentials, live clinic status, rating cards, and rapid booking trigger.

steps.title: Practice Impact Metrics & Accreditations
steps.description: Implement animated counters for patient recoveries, board certifications, clinical trials, and hospital affiliations.

steps.title: Physician Profile & Clinical Philosophy
steps.description: Showcase Dr. Julian Marcus's background, education, fellowships, research publications, and compassionate care ethos.

steps.title: Interactive Clinical Services & Procedure Explorer
steps.description: Build filterable cards detailing cardiology, preventive screenings, hypertension care, ECG diagnostics, and pricing guides.

steps.title: Interactive Cardiovascular Wellness & BMI Risk Calculator
steps.description: Develop local real-time client-side health assessment engine computing BMI, risk tier, and target cardiac zone.

steps.title: Patient Consultation Fee Estimator
steps.description: Implement local business logic calculator that factors base consultation, selected diagnostics, and insurance copay percentage.

steps.title: Multi-Step Appointment Booking Modal
steps.description: Assemble appointment booking flow with live calendar date picker, time slot selector, symptom notes, and instant summary.

steps.title: Patient Authentication & Portal Integration
steps.description: Implement email/password patient login, registration, and OTP forgot password modal adhering to TrumpleDroid API guidelines.

steps.title: Appointment Persistence & Patient Dashboard
steps.description: Enable authenticated booking saving via POST /data, status monitoring via GET /data, and cancellation via DELETE /data.

steps.title: Patient Reviews, FAQs, and Clinic Location
steps.description: Integrate verified patient feedback carousel, interactive accordion FAQs, and clinic hours with direction guides.

steps.title: Building drjulianmarcus
steps.description: Perform comprehensive styling, responsiveness checks, calculation testing, and end-to-end integration.
